faqs.question: Will we lose SEO rankings in a migration?
faqs.answer: Not if it is done right — we map URLs, set 301 redirects, and preserve structured data so rankings and traffic carry over.

faqs.question: Can you move us between platforms?
faqs.answer: Yes — Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, or custom; we migrate products, customers, and order history with validation.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
